title: Compatibility of a right-adjoint mate with an open in the old base
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation, with Y qcqs, and choose a right adjoint a to its canonical lifted derived direct image, with adjunction. Fix an affine open V⊂Y, put U=f⁻¹(V), and assume U qcqs. Let T be qcqs and g_V:T→V, g₀:T→Y satisfy g_V followed by V→Y equals g₀. Choose right adjoints c,b,b′ to the canonical lifted direct images X×_Y T→T, U→V and U×_V T→T, respectively, with their adjunctions. Assume ordinary derived base change for f along g₀ and f restricted to V along g_V. Fix K in D_QCoh(Y). For any scheme Z and maps r:Z→X×_Y T and q:Z→U×_V T, suppose their projections to X (using U→X for q) and T agree. Then the derived pullback along r of the ambient mate for f,g₀ at K is isomorphic as an arrow in D(O_Z) to the derived pullback along q of the ambient mate for U→V,g_V at LV* K. No new-base open and no invertibility of r,q or either mate are assumed. The categories, direct images, canonical mate and derived pullback are those of [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint, def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map, def-pc-derived-pullback]; restriction and ordinary base change are [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps, def-pc-derived-base-change-map], and schemes, properness, flatness and fibre products follow [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-pc-fibre-product].

proof.text: The restriction square U→X over V→Y is cartesian. Since g₀ factors through V, pasting identifies X×_Y T with U×_V T. Cancel the mono U→X and use the supplied projection equations to identify r and q after this isomorphism.

Use [lem-sc-proper-flat-right-adjoint-restriction-open] for f and V. The invertible restricted open unit, open counit, and direct-image composition give the restriction comparison between a and b. Transport the direct images over T along the scheme isomorphism; right-adjoint uniqueness supplies the comparison between c and b′. Pullback composition gives the source comparison.

Expand the mate for f,g₀ into its unit, inverse conjugate of ordinary base change and counit. In the factorization through V, composite adjunction units and counits match those of the two successive squares by their triangle identities. The ordinary base-change compositions agree; conjugation and inversion preserve the equality. Thus the mate for f,g₀ equals the mate for U→V,g_V composed with the invertible open comparison. This yields an arrow isomorphism over X×_Y T. Apply derived pullback along r, and the r,q projection equalities and pullback composition transport it to the asserted arrow isomorphism over Z. This is the old-base-open part of 0E9S and the composition calculation in 0ATR. Functors preserve isomorphisms, so r and q need not be isomorphisms.

theorem rightAdjoint_mate_oldBase_open
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y T Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (V : Y.Opens) [IsAffine V.toScheme]
    [CompactSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme]
    (g0 : T ⟶ Y) (gV : T ⟶ V.toScheme) (hg : gV ≫ V.ι = g0)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g0))
    (adjc : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g0)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g0)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g0)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g0) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ c)
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g0) g0
        (pullback.fst f g0) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (b : schemeDerivedQCohCategory V.toScheme ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (b' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback (f ∣_ V) gV))
    (adjb : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty V.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ V))
      (fun E ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ (f ∣_ V)).fst
        E.obj E.property) ⊣ b)
    (adjb' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (f ∣_ V) gV)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated
          (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ b')
    (hβV : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (f ∣_ V)
        (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV) gV
        (pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) gV) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (r : Z ⟶ pullback f g0)
    (q : Z ⟶ pullback (f ∣_ V) gV)
    (hrq₁ : r ≫ pullback.fst f g0 =
      q ≫ pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) gV ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)
    (hrq₂ : r ≫ pullback.snd f g0 = q ≫ pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) gV) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback r).map
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g0)).ι.map
        (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y T
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
          f g0 a c adjf adjc hβ K))) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback q).map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (f ∣_ V) gV)).ι.map
          (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap (f ∣_ V) gV b b' adjb adjb' hβV
            ⟨(derivedPullback V.ι).obj K.obj,
              (derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh V.ι).1 K.obj K.property⟩))))
